name: Registered Exporter System (REX system)
summary: Registered Exporter System (the REX system) is a system of self-certification of origin by registered exporters making out statements on origin. The system is applied for the products listed under Generalized System of Preferences (GSP) schemes of European Union, Norway, Switzerland and Turkey. It simplifies export formalities by allowing the registered exporter to certify the preferential origin himself by including a specific declaration ( statements on origin) on the invoice or another commercial document identifying the exported products. Thus, the registered exporter does not need to apply upon each export for issue of a certificate of origin. The exporter registration is a one off formality.
